title: documenteR
text: RStudio addin builds skeleton documentation R function dataframe using roxygen2 syntax. addin modified @mdlincoln’s docthis fit Hadley’s notes documenting R packages.

title: Document an R object — documenter
text: function takes name object (either R function R data.frame) replaces skeleton roxygen2 documentation. used documenter_addin() function installed R addin. functions, empty @param generated funciton's arguments. dataframes, full \description block generated column names

title: Document an R object — documenter
text: objname character string naming R function data.frame.

title: Document an R object — documenter
text: addin automatically source file function data .

title: Document an R object — documenter
code:
documenter("lm") #> [1] "
#' @title FUNCTION_TITLE
#'
#' @description FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION
#'
#' @param formula DESCRIPTION.
#' @param data DESCRIPTION.
#' @param subset DESCRIPTION.
#' @param weights DESCRIPTION.
#' @param na.action DESCRIPTION.
#' @param method DESCRIPTION.
#' @param model DESCRIPTION.
#' @param x DESCRIPTION.
#' @param y DESCRIPTION.
#' @param qr DESCRIPTION.
#' @param singular.ok DESCRIPTION.
#' @param contrasts DESCRIPTION.
#' @param offset DESCRIPTION.
#' @param ... DESCRIPTION.
#'
#' @return RETURN_DESCRIPTION
#' @export
lm" #' @title FUNCTION_TITLE #' #' @description FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION #' #' @param formula DESCRIPTION. #' @param data DESCRIPTION. #' @param subset DESCRIPTION. #' @param weights DESCRIPTION. #' @param na.action DESCRIPTION. #' @param method DESCRIPTION. #' @param model DESCRIPTION. #' @param x DESCRIPTION. #' @param y DESCRIPTION. #' @param qr DESCRIPTION. #' @param singular.ok DESCRIPTION. #' @param contrasts DESCRIPTION. #' @param offset DESCRIPTION. #' @param ... DESCRIPTION. #' #' @return RETURN DESCRIPTION #' @export  documenter("iris") #> [1] "
#' DATASET_TITLE
#'
#' DATASET_DESCRIPTION
#'
#' @format A data frame with 150 rows and 5 variables:
#' \describe{
#'   \item{\code{Sepal.Length}}{double. DESCRIPTION.}
#'   \item{\code{Sepal.Width}}{double. DESCRIPTION.}
#'   \item{\code{Petal.Length}}{double. DESCRIPTION.}
#'   \item{\code{Petal.Width}}{double. DESCRIPTION.}
#'   \item{\code{Species}}{integer. DESCRIPTION.}
#' }
"iris"" #' DATASET_TITLE #' #' DATASET_DESCRIPTION #' #' @format A data frame with 150 rows and 5 variables: #' \describe{ #'   \item{\code{Sepal.Length}}{double. DESCRIPTION.} #'   \item{\code{Sepal.Width}}{double. DESCRIPTION.} #'   \item{\code{Petal.Length}}{double. DESCRIPTION.} #'   \item{\code{Petal.Width}}{double. DESCRIPTION.} #'   \item{\code{Species}}{integer. DESCRIPTION.} #' }
